title: Base script
description: The single source of truth for everything downstream. One segment = one frame + one narration chunk.

schema_version.description: Bumped only on breaking changes. Consumers reject anything they do not know.

style_prompt.description: Prepended VERBATIM to every image prompt. This block is the entire consistency mechanism in v1 - keep it byte-identical across every generation.

negative_prompt.description: Also prepended verbatim (as the negative side) to every image prompt. Mechanically enforced by the derive step.

narration.description: Exactly what the TTS speaks. Written for the ear.

scene_intent.description: The visual meaning of the frame, written for a human. Not the image prompt; that is derived.

duration_hint_s.description: Advisory pacing intent only. The assembler ignores it; audio is the master clock.
